title: Senior Executive – Data, MIS & Reporting
description:
**About Medhavi Skills University**

Medhavi Skills University (MSU) is a government-notified private State Skills University established under a State Act in Sikkim in 2021, dedicated to advancing quality skill-integrated higher education and entrepreneurship. Recognised by the UGC and aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, MSU is a pioneer in converging the skilling ecosystem with formal higher education through its “Industry as Campus” model. The University collaborates extensively with industries and Skill Development Institutes to deliver work-integrated degree programs embedding structured on-the-job training within the curriculum. MSU is a recognised Awarding Body under NCVET, empanelled with DGT, and serves as an anchor university partner with NSDC and the PMU of NSDC International-collectively reinforcing its demand-driven, industry-co-led academic framework.Ranked 4th among India’s Top Skill Universities in the Outlook ICARE Rankings 2025 and supported by over 11 defence partnerships along with multiple national recognitions, MSU stands among India’s leading skill-integrated higher education institutions.

For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in

**About Medhavi Group:**

Established in 2013, Medhavi Group is a unified ecosystem comprising MSU and various skill-promoting organisations, dedicated to advancing skill development, vocational training, and industry-integrated higher education. With a strong outcome-driven approach, the Group has trained over 6

lakh learners, achieving more than 70% employability outcomes, and currently supports 20,000+ active students across its diverse programs. Medhavi Group continues to bridge the gap between education and employment by building scalable, industry-aligned talent pathways across India. Work Integrated Skill based Higher Education (WISE) is Medhavi’s flagship industry-integrated initiative built on the principle of “Industry as Campus.” It combines academic learning with structured on-the-job training, ensuring students graduate with real work experience and industry-ready skills. Through deep, outcome-driven partnerships with over 300+ leading industry and skill partners across 26+ sectors including Hyundai, Mahindra, IHG Group, Nephroplus, Barbeque Nation, Nexus Select Malls,ClassPlus, Tata Electronics, Marriott, ITC, and others- WISE enables learners to acquire role- specific competencies directly within live business environments. WISE creates a demand-driven talent pipeline for industries that enhances employability, improves workforce productivity, and bridges the industry skill gap.

For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in/wise

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical MIS & Data Analyst to manage institutional data,develop management information systems, and ensure data accuracy, consistency and integrity across various functions of the University. The role will involve maintaining centralised databases, developing automated MIS reports and dashboards, reconciling data across multiple platforms, and supporting regulatory reporting and institutional ranking requirements such as NIRF, NAAC, AISHE and UGC.The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Excel, SQL and data visualisation tools, along with the ability to translate complex data into meaningful insights for management decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Data Management & Governance**

* Maintain accurate, updated and validated master databases covering students, academic programmes, examinations, industry partners and employees.
* Establish and maintain standardised data management processes, data dictionaries and validation protocols.
* Ensure data consistency, completeness and integrity across various institutional databases and systems.
* Maintain a comprehensive log of data discrepancies, track resolution and ensure timely closure of identified issues.

**2. MIS Reporting & Dashboard Development**

* Develop, maintain and circulate periodic MIS reports, including weekly, monthly and ad-hoc reports for senior management.
* Design interactive dashboards to monitor key institutional, academic and operational performance indicators.
* Analyse large datasets to identify trends, gaps, deviations and actionable insights.
* Automate recurring reports and streamline data consolidation and reporting processes.

**3. Data Reconciliation & Validation**

* Conduct monthly data reconciliation across ERP, Admissions, Finance, HR, Academic Operations and industry partner databases.
* Identify data mismatches, investigate discrepancies and coordinate with respective departments for necessary corrections.
* Validate examination, assessment, result and certificate-related data to ensure accuracy before publication or release.
* Implement data validation checks to minimise errors and maintain consistency across reporting systems.

**4. Regulatory & Compliance Reporting**

* Compile, validate and maintain institutional data required for statutory, regulatory, accreditation and ranking submissions.
* Support data preparation and documentation for NIRF, NAAC, AISHE, UGC and other regulatory or institutional reporting requirements.
* Ensure that all reported figures are accurate, traceable and supported by appropriate documentary evidence.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to collect, verify and consolidate data within definedsubmission timelines.

**5. Process Automation & Data Analytics**

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive MIS and data management activities using Google Apps Script, Power Automate, Python or other relevant tools.
* Leverage AI-enabled tools for data analysis, report generation and process optimisation.
* Develop standardised reporting templates and workflows to improve operational efficiency.
* Ensure confidentiality, access control and secure handling of institutional and sensitive data.

**Preferred Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline with strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving abilities.Candidates from B.Sc., B.Com, BCA, B.Tech, BBA or equivalent backgrounds will be preferred.
* 2–3 years of relevant experience in MIS, Data Analytics, Business Analytics or Compliance Reporting.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP,HLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, Power Query, data validation and advanced formulas.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data extraction, querying and analysis.
* Hands-on experience in dashboard development using Power BI, Looker Studio or equivalent visualisation tools.
* Knowledge of report automation using Google Apps Script, Power Automate or Python will be an added advantage.
* Familiarity with ERP systems, university databases, EdTech platforms and institutional data management.
* Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, ownership, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data and insights clearly.
* Ability to handle confidential institutional information with discretion.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to architect and scale a future-focused, industry-integrated higher education ecosystem.
* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.
* A collaborative, mission-driven environment.
* The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience at careers@msu.edu.in at earliest possible.

Medhavi Skills University is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Manager/Sr. Manager – People Strategy & Organisation Transformation
description:
**Role Purpose**

The incumbent will support the VP – People Strategy & Organisation Transformation in building a scalable, productive and future-ready organisation aligned with the Group’s business strategy and growth objectives. The role will work with business leaders and functional teams to drive organisation design, strategic workforce planning, manpower productivity, people cost optimization, people analytics and organisation transformation initiatives.The role requires a combination of strategic thinking, analytical capability, business understanding and strong project execution skills. The individual must translate business requirements into actionable insights, recommendations and

measurable implementation plans.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Organisation Design & Effectiveness**

* Support organisation design initiatives across business verticals, functions and group entities.
* Analyse organisational structures, reporting relationships, spans of control, layers and role overlaps.
* Identify opportunities to improve organisational effectiveness, accountability, decision-making and operating efficiency.
* Develop organisation charts, role-mapping documents, responsibility matrices and governance frameworks.
* Support role clarity, job architecture and organisation restructuring initiatives.

**B. Strategic Workforce Planning & Manpower Productivity**

* Partner with business leaders to assess current and future workforce requirements against business plans and growth projections.
* Assess resource utilisation, capacity, productivity and capability gaps.
* Compare existing and proposed manpower requirements and identify opportunities for redeployment, role consolidation and improved utilisation.
* Develop workforce plans, headcount projections and manpower scenarios aligned with business priorities.
* Evaluate workforce requirements against relevant productivity measures, such as operational output, service levels,revenue or enrolments.
* Support a structured manpower budgeting and approval framework.

**C. People Cost & Workforce Economics**

* Analyse employee costs across business units, functions, levels and locations.
* Build manpower cost models covering headcount, compensation, vacancies, new hiring and projected workforce expenditure.
* Identify cost drivers, cost variances and opportunities to improve workforce efficiency without compromising critical capabilities.
* Prepare financial scenarios and business cases for organisational changes, hiring plans and workforce investments.
* Track approved manpower budgets against actual expenditure and forecasts.
* Partner with Finance to validate assumptions, quantify financial impact and monitor realised benefits.

**D. Strategic Business Partnering**

* Work with business leaders to understand business priorities, organisational challenges and future capability requirements.
* Translate business challenges into organisation, workforce and capability interventions.
* Prepare decision-support notes and recommendations for leadership discussions.
* Highlight workforce risks, capability gaps, productivity concerns and organisation effectiveness issues during business reviews.
* Establish ownership, timelines and expected outcomes with stakeholders.

**E. Organisation Transformation & Project Management**

* Drive strategic people and organisation transformation projects from diagnosis through implementation.
* Develop project charters, implementation roadmaps, milestone trackers, risk registers and governance mechanisms.
* Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving business, Finance, People & Culture, operations and other relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor implementation progress, manage dependencies and escalate delays or risks.
* Support change impact assessments, stakeholder communication plans and adoption tracking.
* Measure the business impact and sustainability of implemented changes.

**F. People Analytics & Management Reporting**

* Develop dashboards and reports covering headcount, manpower cost, productivity, workforce mix, vacancies and organisational effectiveness.
* Analyse workforce trends and translate data into actionable business insights.
* Establish consistent definitions, reporting standards and data-validation mechanisms for strategic workforce metrics.
* Prepare periodic leadership reviews highlighting trends, risks, opportunities and recommended interventions.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of workforce investments and organisational changes using data.

**G. Leadership & Capability Strategy**

* Support the identification of critical roles, leadership capability gaps and succession risks.
* Assist in developing frameworks for critical-role identification, leadership pipeline assessment and succession readiness.
* Analyse future skill requirements and capability gaps arising from business expansion, technology adoption and operating-model changes.
* Partner with the HR execution team to translate capability priorities into development plans.
* Support strategic talent reviews and leadership workforce planning.

**H. Governance & Strategic Execution**

* Track strategic people initiatives, leadership decisions and agreed organisational actions.
* Maintain a consolidated view of transformation priorities, progress, dependencies, risks and outcomes.
* Prepare leadership presentations, decision papers, business cases and executive summaries.
* Ensure recommendations are supported by validated data, financial implications, risk assessments and measurable outcomes.
* Maintain confidentiality and sound governance when handling workforce information and organisational decisions.

**Key Deliverables**

* Organisation Effectiveness Review: assessment of structures, reporting relationships, layers, spans and role overlaps.
* Strategic Workforce Plan: current workforce assessment, projected requirements, capability gaps and future manpower scenarios.
* Manpower Cost & Productivity Dashboard: consolidated view of headcount, workforce expenditure, productivity indicators and budget variances.
* Workforce Business Cases: data-backed recommendations for resource deployment, hiring priorities, restructuring and productivity improvement.
* Organisation Transformation Tracker: milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, risks and realised outcomes.
* Leadership Workforce Review: insights on critical roles, leadership gaps, succession risks and future capability requirements.
* Strategic Decision Papers: concise recommendations supported by analysis and implementation plans.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Timely completion of organisation and workforce assessments for identified business units.
* Accuracy and reliability of manpower, compensation cost and productivity analysis.
* Quality and action-ability of workforce planning recommendations.
* Timely preparation of workforce budgets, forecasts and management dashboards.
* Progress against approved organisation transformation milestones.
* Quantified financial benefits and productivity improvements from implemented initiatives.
* Adoption and effectiveness of agreed organisation design and workforce interventions.
* Stakeholder satisfaction with the quality of analysis, recommendations and project delivery.

Performance targets will be agreed with the reporting manager based on business priorities and the availability of reliable baseline data.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, Finance or a relateddiscipline.
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in organisation development, workforce planning, people strategy, HR transformation, management consulting, business analysis or a related field.
* Experience in organisation design, manpower planning, productivity analysis, workforce budgeting or transformation project management.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders and translating business requirements into structured recommendations.
* Experience in a multi-business, multi-location or rapidly scaling organisation is an advantage.
* Exposure to consulting, business transformation or financial modelling is preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strategic thinking: connects workforce decisions with business objectives.
* Analytical capability: strong proficiency in Excel, data analysis, scenario modelling and dashboard development.
* Business acumen: understands operating models, manpower economics, productivity and financial implications.
* Problem-solving: diagnoses underlying issues and develops practical, evidence-based recommendations.
* Project management: strong planning, execution, stakeholder coordination and follow-through.
* Communication: presents complex analysis in a concise, leadership-friendly manner.
* Stakeholder management: confident working with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
* Attention to detail: strong data validation, documentation and analytical discipline.
* Ownership: works independently, manages ambiguity and drives initiatives to completion.

**Role Boundaries**

The position sits within People Strategy & Organisation Transformation and is distinct from day-to-day HR operations.

**Primary focus**

* Strategic workforce planning and organisation effectiveness.
* Manpower economics and productivity analysis.
* Organisation design and transformation projects.
* Strategic people analytics and decision support.
* Leadership workforce planning and capability strategy.

Activities owned by designated HR execution teams

* Recruitment operations and hiring administration.
* Employee lifecycle transactions and routine HR operations.
* PMS administration and appraisal-cycle execution.
* Routine employee engagement and HR service delivery.
* Day-to-day HRIS administration and operational reporting.

The incumbent will partner with HR execution teams wherever strategic analysis or transformation support is required.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a structured thinker who can work with imperfect data, ask the right business questions and turn

analysis into practical decisions. The individual should be comfortable engaging with business leaders, challenging

assumptions constructively, building financial and workforce models, and ensuring that agreed initiatives are implemented.

The candidate must combine strategic orientation with hands-on execution capability and independently manage

work streams while keeping the VP informed of key decisions, risks and outcomes.

**How to apply**

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience at

careers@medhavione.com at earliest possible.

**About MedhaviOne**

MedhaviOne is building India's education-to-employment infrastructure: shared standards for skills and credentials that connect institutions, employers and learners.

We are not an early-stage startup. The Medhavi Group already has:

* 600+ enterprise partners across 30+ sectors, including Hyundai, Mahindra, MRF, Daikin, IHG Hotels and the Indian Navy; 650,000+ learners reached across India
* Its own skills university, Medhavi Skills University, with close to 2,000 students on campus

The base is built. We now need people to build the next businesses on top of it.

For more information, visit https://medhavione.com

**About Medhavi Group:**

Established in 2013, Medhavi Group is a unified ecosystem comprising MSU and various skill-promoting organisations,dedicated to advancing skill development, vocational training, and industry-integrated higher education. having trained 6+ lakh learners with 70%+ employability outcomes and supporting 20,000+ active students.

* WISE (Work Integrated Skill-based Higher Education) is Medhavi’s flagship initiative, built on the principle of “Industry on Campus”, combining academic learning with structured on-the-job training.
* Through partnerships with 300+ leading organisations across 26+ sectors, including Hyundai, Mahindra, IHG Group, Marriott, ITC and Tata Electronics, WISE builds industry-aligned talent pipelines.
* WISE enables students to graduate with real work experience and industry-ready skills, enhancing employability, workforce productivity, and bridging the industry skill gap.

For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in/wise

title: Learning Delivery Consultant - Global Learning
description:
**Your Role**
-------------

Ready to make a global impact through learning? We are looking for an experienced Learning Delivery Consultant (Program Manager) to help bring world-class learning experiences to life. In this role, you will partner with Learning Business Partners, Talent Directors, facilitators, administrators, and key stakeholders to plan, coordinate, and deliver high-quality learning programs for a global audience.

  

You will be at the heart of delivery excellence, ensuring learning programs run smoothly from planning through execution. Combining project management, stakeholder engagement, analytics, and operational expertise, you will create outstanding learner experiences while continuously improving how learning is delivered.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Delivery**

* Manage end-to-end delivery of facilitated, virtual, digital, and face-to-face learning programs and events.
* Gather, validate, and coordinate program requirements.
* Key contact for Learning Business Partners, facilitators, and stakeholders.
* Ensure delivery milestones and timelines are achieved.

  

**Program Readiness & Quality**

* Ensure facilitators, materials, documentation, and resources are in place.
* Maintain accurate program information and schedules.
* Monitor delivery quality, consistency, and execution standards.
* Identify risks and support mitigation activities.

  

**Stakeholder & Facilitator Management**

* Build strong partnerships with Learning Business Partners, Talent Directors, Facilitator Administrators, and delivery teams.
* Coordinate communications across stakeholder groups.
* Support facilitator planning, onboarding, and readiness activities.
* Deliver briefings and monitor qualification levels.

  

**Reporting, Analytics & Governance**

* Produce and maintain reports, dashboards, and performance metrics.
* Analyze learner feedback, participation trends, and delivery data.
* Provide recommendations to improve delivery effectiveness.
* Support governance through reporting and performance monitoring.

  

**Financial Management**

* Track budgets, forecasts, and related financial activities.
* Maintain accurate financial records and reporting.
* Support effective financial governance.

  

**Learner Participation & Engagement**

* Support initiatives that increase learner participation and program reach.
* Monitor registrations, attendance, and feedback.
* Help enhance engagement and learner satisfaction.

  

**Continuous Improvement**

* Share delivery best practices across the learning function.
* Collaborate on enhancements informed by learner feedback and insights.
* Drive improvements that strengthen efficiency, quality, and effectiveness.

  

**Event Coordination**

* Coordinate venue, logistical, and operational requirements for face-to-face programs/events.

**Your Profile**
----------------

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

**Essential Experience**

* Experience in Learning & Development, HR, Talent, or a related environment.
* Experience coordinating programs, projects, or events involving multiple stakeholders.
* Experience supporting virtual, digital, and classroom learning solutions.
* Experience using reporting, analytics, and performance data.

  

**Essential Skills**

* Strong project management skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
* Strong communication skills.
* Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and recommend actions.
* Strong attention to detail, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Manage competing priorities and deliver to deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Copilot.
* Adaptability, accountability, ownership, creativity, and a continuous improvement mindset.

  

**Personal Attributes**

* Learner and customer focused.
* Collaborative across global and cross-functional teams.
* Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
* Resilient, proactive, and adaptable.
* Committed to operational excellence and outstanding delivery.
* Passionate about creating meaningful learning experiences.

**What you will love about working here**
-----------------------------------------

* We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support in hybrid mode, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance
* Our focus will be your career growth & professional development to support you in exploring the world of opportunities.
* Equip yourself with valuable certifications & training programmes in the latest technologies such as Gen AI.

title: Delivery & Release Coordinator (UAT and Quality) - IFS Logistics
description:
**Company Description**

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

 **Job Description**

**About IFS Logistics**

IFS Logistics is an AI enterprise logistics platform that helps shippers and logistics businesses connect transport data, manage carrier spend and automate execution. Originally launched as 7bridges, the product is now part of IFS and is developed by a small, dedicated team.

**The role**

We are looking for a Delivery & Release Coordinator to manage user acceptance testing, release activity and day-to-day delivery coordination across the product team.

The team is preparing for its first IFS Cloud customer go-live, bringing a new API into production and recruiting a significant number of new colleagues. As the pace of delivery increases, we need clear ownership of test cycles, defects, release readiness and communication.

You will coordinate UAT with customers and internal stakeholders, maintain release plans and checklists, track defects through to resolution and support go/no-go decisions. You will work closely with Lorraine Hassall, our Quality Manager, allowing her to focus on quality standards and strategy while you manage the practical coordination required to apply them consistently.

Most of the role is focused on UAT, releases and delivery. It also includes a smaller amount of team coordination, particularly onboarding, in-person sessions, travel planning, and financial coordination.

**What you'll work on**

**UAT and release management**

* Plan and coordinate UAT cycles with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Confirm scope, participants, test windows, evidence and sign-off for each cycle.
* Track defects from identification through triage, ownership, resolution and closure.
* Support on the release calendar, release notes, readiness checklist and go/no-go process.
* Coordinate with other teams in IFS as the product is integrated with IFS Cloud.
* Support the UAT and release plan for Project Oliver and the first IFS Cloud customer go-live.

**Supporting the quality function**

* Work with the Quality Manager on test processes, evidence and audit trails.
* Help apply standards such as clear acceptance criteria, merge-request review and controlled production releases.
* Support the move from periodic manual QA towards per-ticket quality assurance and more frequent releases.

**Delivery coordination**

* Keep Jira accurate, with current statuses, acceptance criteria and links to relevant merge requests.
* Maintain useful documentation and decision records in Notion.
* Prepare concise delivery and release updates for product and engineering leads.
* Identify risks early, clarify ownership and follow actions through to completion.

**Team coordination**

* Organise onboarding logistics for new starters and monthly in-person sessions in Staines.
* Coordinate team travel, expenses and purchase orders.

 **Qualifications**

**What we're looking for**

* Strong organisation and follow-through, with a habit of identifying and addressing issues early.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* The ability to work constructively with engineers and maintain agreed standards when priorities are competing.
* A practical, accountable approach to moving work forward without waiting for detailed direction.
* Experience coordinating UAT, software releases or delivery within a product or engineering team.
* Familiarity with release notes, test cycles, defect tracking, go/no-go decisions, acceptance criteria and regression scope.
* Experience managing a defect list through triage and resolution rather than only reporting its status.
* Confidence using Jira and a documentation platform such as Notion or Confluence.

Relevant backgrounds may include delivery coordination, release coordination, junior delivery management, QA coordination, scrum mastery or project coordination. We are more interested in what you have managed than in your previous job title.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with enterprise software involving customer UAT and formal sign-off.
* Exposure to regulated or audited environments, ERP products or supply-chain software.
* ISTQB, Agile or delivery certification.
* Experience working within a large organisation with established procurement and HR processes.
* Experience using AI tools to draft release notes, summarise defect lists or prepare status updates.

**Tools**

The team uses Jira, Notion, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft 365 and Outlook, along with IFS systems for travel, expenses and purchasing. You do not need to write code, but you should be comfortable working with engineers and understanding their delivery processes.

**What success looks like in the first six months**

* Releases follow a predictable cadence and include clear, accurate release notes.
* Each UAT cycle has an agreed owner, schedule, defect list, evidence and sign-off.
* Customer and support defects receive clear ownership and a visible route to resolution.
* The Project Oliver go-live is supported by a well-managed UAT and release plan.
* Acceptance criteria, review and release controls are applied consistently.
* Product and engineering leads spend less time on routine coordination and administration.

**Why we're hiring now**

The product team is growing and preparing for several important releases. The Quality Manager currently carries much of the practical coordination associated with testing and releases. This role will provide dedicated support of that work, helping the team increase delivery frequency while maintaining clear quality and release controls.

 **Additional Information**

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

title: HR Assistant
description:
**Job Title:** Learning and Development (L&D) Officer

**Department:** Human Resources

**Reports To:** HR Manager

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a structured and passion-driven **Learning and Development (L&D) Officer** to support the growth, capability building, and professional evolution of our workforce. In this role, you will be responsible for mapping out annual training cycles, identifying skills gaps, administering our Learning Management System (LMS), and coordinating impact-driven educational programs.The ideal candidate blends strong project management abilities with deep empathy for adult learning needs, ensuring that our team members have the resources they need to thrive and hit both personal and organizational milestones.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Identify Training Needs:** Conduct organization-wide training needs analyses (TNA) by surveying employees, evaluating performance data, and consulting with department heads to pinpoint critical skills gaps.
* **Coordinate Programs:** Oversee the logistical execution of internal workshops, e-learning paths, job-shadowing initiatives, and third-party vendor sessions.
* **Manage LMS Infrastructure:** Serve as the primary administrator for the company’s Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring courses are up to date, accessible, and tracked accurately.
* **Content Curation & Creation:** Assist in designing instructional materials, user guides, digital modules, and interactive onboarding toolkits tailored to modern learning styles.
* **Track Metrics & ROI:** Collect training feedback, monitor completion rates, and run analytics reports to evaluate program effectiveness and report on business impact.
* **Vendor Management:** Source, vet, and maintain relationships with external coaches, trainers, and educational software providers under budget constraints.
* **Support Career Pathing:** Partner with the broader HR team to design clear development paths that support succession planning and talent retention.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* 3PL: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Description**

  

**1. Employee Lifecycle Administration**

  

* Support end-to-end administrative activities for employee onboarding and separation.
* Coordinate employee documentation, office access, ID cards, welcome kits and other joining requirements.
* Facilitate registration of employees for transport, meal benefits, medical insurance and workplace facilities.
* Coordinate exit-related activities including asset recovery, access deactivation, exclusion form transport & insurance and closure documentation.
Maintain accurate employee administration records and trackers.  

  

**2. Employee Benefits Administration**

  

**a.****Meal Benefits & Cafeteria**

  

* Administer employee meal benefits and cafeteria-related services.
* Process employee registrations, activations, deactivations and monthly meal credit allocations.
* Reconcile employee eligibility and meal consumption records.
* Coordinate with vendors for service delivery, invoice validation and issue resolution.
Address employee queries related to meal benefits and cafeteria services.  

  

**b.****Insurance administration & support**

  

* Coordinate employee enrolments, exclusions and periodic updates under the medical insurance policy.
* Liaise with insurance providers/partners for employee additions and deletions.
* Maintain insurance-related employee records and supporting documents.
Assist employees with insurance-related queries and coordinate resolution with relevant stakeholders.  

  

**c.****Transport Administration**

  

* Administer employee transportation services and applicable conveyance allowance processes.
* Manage employee transport preferences, registrations, route allocation and onboarding.
* Maintain updated transport databases and monthly employee rosters.
* Coordinate with transport vendors for smooth and uninterrupted service delivery.
* Monitor transport utilization and support monthly billing reconciliation.
* Resolve employee queries and escalations relating to transport services.
Support periodic transport preference exercises and employee communications.  

  

**d.****Travel & Relocation Coordination**

  

* Coordinate domestic business travel requirements including flights, hotels and local transportation.
* Support employee relocation and other approved travel requirements.
* Ensure travel arrangements comply with applicable company policies and approval processes.
* Maintain travel records and support expense claim documentation.
Liaise with travel partners for timely and cost-effective arrangements.  

  

**5. Vendor Management & Procurement**

  

* Support vendor onboarding, documentation and vendor code creation.
* Coordinate procurement of office supplies, ID cards, welcome kits, employee gifts, event materials and other administrative requirements.
* Obtain quotations, prepare comparative statements and coordinate internal approvals.
* Maintain vendor records, agreements and supporting documentation.
Follow up with vendors to ensure timely delivery and appropriate service quality.  

  

**6. Invoice Processing & Financial Coordination**

  

* Manage administrative invoices from receipt through validation, approval and submission to Finance.
* Process invoices relating to transport, meal services, travel, telecom, ID cards, administrative purchases, employee engagement activities and other operational vendors.
* Verify invoices against agreed commercials, supporting documents and services delivered.
* Maintain invoice trackers and follow up to ensure timely processing and payment.
Maintain appropriate documentation for audit and compliance requirements.  

  

**7. Corporate Prepaid Card Administration**

  

* Track and reconcile expenses incurred through corporate prepaid cards.
* Reconcile transactions with appropriate invoices, bills and approvals.
* Prepare periodic expenditure summaries and supporting documentation.
* Ensure expenses are appropriately recorded and allocated.
Maintain records required for financial review and audit purposes.  

  

**8. Facilities & Workplace Administration**

  

* Support day-to-day office administration and workplace operations.
* Coordinate with facility teams for employee requirements and workplace-related concerns.
* Support parking, gym, access control, security, visitor management and other workplace services.
* Coordinate visitor access and meeting room requirements, wherever applicable.
Help maintain a safe, organized and employee-friendly workplace.  

  

**9. Employee Support**

  

* Act as a point of contact for routine employee administration queries.
* Provide support on transport, insurance, meal benefits, travel, facilities and other workplace services.
* Track employee requests and ensure timely closure or escalation to the appropriate stakeholder.
* Communicate service updates and administrative information clearly to employees.
Support employee engagement activities and workplace initiatives as required.  

  
  
  

**10. Reporting, Documentation & Compliance**

  

* Maintain accurate operational trackers, databases and administrative records.
* Prepare periodic reports relating to transport, benefits, invoices, vendors and employee services.
* Maintain appropriate documents and records in accordance with organizational guidelines.
* Support internal/external audits by providing required records and supporting documentation.
Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve turnaround time and enhance administrative efficiency.  

  
  
  

### **Requirements**

* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong coordination and follow-up skills
* **Ability to work on multiple areas simultaneously**
* **Good time management skills**
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Employee/customer service orientation
* Vendor coordination and relationship management
* Basic understanding of invoice processing and reconciliation
* Ability to manage multiple activities and priorities
* Working knowledge of **MS Excel, MS Word and PowerPoint**
* Good documentation and record-management skills
Ability to work effectively with employees, vendors and cross-functional teams  

  

* **Education:** Graduate in any discipline
* **Experience:** 1.5–3.5 years of relevant experience in Administration, HR Operations, Employee Services, Facilities or a similar role preferred.
* Prior exposure to employee transport, vendor coordination, invoice processing, facilities, travel or employee benefits administration would be an advantage.
